pilot.pooling_rule: rowwise arithmetic mean of the three complete ordinal labels, preserving the published pilot method
pilot.privacy: tracked artifacts use Ann. A/B/C only; participant names, raw label rows, notes, and absolute source paths are excluded

secondary.definition: rowwise arithmetic mean of run01, run02, and run03

score_instances.identity_boundary: Ko run01/run02/run03 are three stochastic instances of one maintained implementation, not three architectures; native raw model scales are not treated as interchangeable

join_contract.cardinality: one-to-one for manifest, every annotator, every primary score instance, and the secondary aggregate
join_contract.missing_labels: forbidden; no listwise deletion or partial pooling
join_contract.text_and_legacy_score_fields: identity audit only; labels join exclusively by sent_id

analysis.principal_measure: Spearman rank correlation using average ranks for ties
analysis.model_human_outputs: each primary score instance versus every human target by corpus
analysis.model_model_outputs: all unordered pairwise primary score-instance Spearman correlations by corpus
analysis.secondary_outputs: Ko rowwise mean versus each human target and each primary score instance by corpus

bootstrap.joint_resampling: one index draw per replicate is applied jointly to all score instances and all annotator/pooled-label columns
bootstrap.stream_derivation: SHA-256 of master seed and corpus_id, first 8 bytes interpreted unsigned little-endian
bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile 95% interval at quantiles 0.025 and 0.975
bootstrap.paired_contrasts: within each human target, all unordered differences rho(model_a,human)-rho(model_b,human) use the same replicate draws
bootstrap.degenerate_replicates: record and exclude a replicate only when either member is constant or the correlation is nonfinite; paired contrasts require both correlations finite

analysis.multiplicity: all estimates and intervals are descriptive; no multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis tests, p-value selection, or winner selection
analysis.claim_boundary: human correspondence and model agreement are not accuracy; labels are non-expert ordinal pilot judgments, not gold-standard truth

outputs.metadata: run_metadata.json with hashes, identities, coverage, bootstrap validity, command, and environment; no raw labels, participant names, notes, sentences, or absolute paths

stop_conditions: any config, manifest, sentence, score, checkpoint, or label hash mismatch
pilot manifest does not contain exactly 40 unique rows per corpus
annotator sent_id sets or row order differ from the frozen manifest
any missing, non-integer, or out-of-range label
any missing, duplicate, nonfinite, or out-of-range model score
any primary score instance lacks exact 40/40 coverage
fewer than 95% of bootstrap replicates are valid for any reported interval or contrast
a scientific or join rule would need to change after Ko-human outcome inspection
